workflow_lessons: Page-unit audit harness pattern observed across Noether, Weber, SGA6, and Steinitz: canonical TeX + source inventory + page/object unit manifest + chunk-on-demand renderer; OCR/raw drops are locator-only; exact anchors must be distinguished from line hints; public claims must separate audit-ready, source-witnessed, source-repaired, source-certified, and critical-edition states.
